aboutGame.title: What is Lootborne?
paragraphs: Lootborne is a dark fantasy idle RPG and auto battler on Steam from developer Fate Rate. You build a hero around the loot you find, pushing through seven regions of dungeons and elite packs while your gear, not just your level, decides how far you can go.

The game ships with 424 items across six rarity tiers, a level 60 progression track, 35 enemy types, and asynchronous PvP. Whether you are chasing a legendary weapon, farming gold for rerolls, or optimizing a build for the arena, our Lootborne Wiki covers every system with practical guides and data tables.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Lootborne.

items.question: What is Lootborne?
items.answer: Lootborne is a dark fantasy idle RPG and auto battler on Steam from developer Fate Rate. You build a hero around the loot you find, clearing dungeons and elite packs across seven regions.

items.question: What platforms is Lootborne available on?
items.answer: Lootborne is available on PC through Steam. It is a single-player idle RPG with asynchronous PvP features rather than a real-time online game.

items.question: How much content does Lootborne have?
items.answer: Lootborne includes 424 items across six rarity tiers, a level 60 progression track, seven regions, 35 enemy types, and 27 Steam achievements.

items.question: What is the Lootborne level cap?
items.answer: The Lootborne level cap is 60. Reaching it opens the endgame, where gear rolls, runes, and gems matter far more than raw character level.

items.question: Does Lootborne have codes?
items.answer: Lootborne codes are short developer-issued strings that grant free rewards. They are case-sensitive, usually one per account, and expire quickly, so redeem them the day you find them.

items.question: Does Lootborne have PvP?
items.answer: Yes. Lootborne features asynchronous PvP battles and leaderboards, where build choices and cooldown timing matter more than raw gear score.

items.question: Where should a new Lootborne player start?
items.answer: Start with the Lootborne beginner guide, then follow the fastest leveling and gold farming routes to build a stable foundation before chasing endgame gear.
